privacy.companyDefinition: Registered company-data RAG questions; synthetic ad-account exports are counted separately, within the Other reporting slice.
privacy.businessDataDefinition: Company-document RAG questions plus synthetic ad-account exports. This broader privacy count does not reclassify cost/routing workload slices.
privacy.questionOnlyMeaning: Redacted question plus bounded minimum redacted source spans when needed; no local draft, Guard verdict, receipt or PII map. Question-only does not mean context-free.
privacy.guardStatus: Pending: Stage 3 replay made no outbound/inbound Guard calls and delivered no cloud payload. Proposed handoffs are pre-Guard deferred candidates.
privacy.privacyCheckScope: Saved wire allowlist, hashes, no draft and recognized raw-private-pattern checks pass. This is local potential-payload inspection, not a universal PII guarantee or remote-delivery attestation.

recommendation.label: Gemma 3 12B for company data
recommendation.scope: Demo deployment candidate; use the locked company policy and all citation/completeness/truncation gates. Escalate other safe tasks through Guard and redaction; keep adversarial items local.
recommendation.reason: The frozen company slice accepts 13/16 locally with 13/13 full-credit answers. Other model/slice policies remain abstentions.

certification.certifiedScope: Accepted CALIB+AUDIT dev items only; not FIT/SELECT, final test, future questions or unseen source families
notCertified: Universal PII removal or post-Guard remote delivery
certification.intervalLabel: Wilson 95% IID sensitivity; accepted answers share source/template families.

summaryParagraph: On the frozen 60-question comparison, Gemma 12B answered 13 of 16 company-data questions locally; all 13 accepted answers received full rubric credit. Its Wilson IID sensitivity interval is 77.2–100.0%. Llama 8B and Gemma 4B continue to abstain. The 3.66% upper error bound applies only to the fixed accepted dev frame; future traffic remains uncertified. Every cloud answer and all spending remain deferred: this report made zero cloud calls and spent $0.

pricing.label: Illustrative planning assumptions, not verified provider invoice prices
pricing.outputProjectionLabel: Per-item-category answer and reasoning lengths are assumptions, not observed cloud output. Their sum never exceeds the shared output cap.

gemini.specialTokens: No automatic BOS/EOS or undocumented server chat framing
gemini.limitation: Google SDK selects this public tokenizer for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; the local SDK is experimental/text-only. Hidden server framing and tokenizer deployment revisions are not measured by an API request.

muse-spark.limitation: Muse Spark has no public tokenizer in this project. Installed Llama 3.1 BPE counts are a documented proxy, not actual Muse Spark billed tokens.
muse-spark.specialTokens: No automatic BOS/EOS or undocumented server chat framing

tokenCounting.scope: Saved provider-specific offline input content counts. Gemini uses its pinned SDK-selected tokenizer; Muse Spark uses the documented Llama BPE proxy. Actual provider billing/framing are unknown.

workloadAssumptions: Company share varies; the observed saved60 composition within company and within noncompany stays fixed. The noncompany remainder includes MMLU-Pro, one GPQA item, instructions, privacy and safety; unsafe items have zero cloud fees in both plans. Models and populations are never pooled.
notes: No new inference, retrieval, grading, calibration, Guard screening, provider token endpoint or cloud request was performed.
Primary saved60, plain50 control and dev AUDIT are separate; repeated IDs are never pooled.
Company arithmetic is an overlay across single/multi-document tasks and is not an additive partition.
The primary and control GPQA slices each contain only one question; no broad hard-reasoning accuracy claim is supported.
Unknown accepted labels count conservatively as wrong. Zero accepted answers have undefined accuracy and Wilson intervals.
Median latency sums the saved local stages and reconstructed retrieval, excludes warm-up, and omits unavailable Guard/cloud completion.
All cloud fees are conditional pre-Guard projections. Real offline input counts are combined with assumed visible output/reasoning lengths and unit prices; no actual invoices or cloud accuracy exist.
The recommendation is advisory; this report does not switch the production gateway model or certify future traffic.
All-company-data queries remained on the machine physically; fully local answers count only accepted answers, while proposed handoffs remain deferred.
